verdict.rationale: The FileDoc.do page links straight into filing flows for LLCs, corporations, name reservations and foreign entities, with no account step shown. The conversions flow branches on whether the entity is already on file, which hints at an existing-record entry path. However, no published page states outright that filing works without an account or by file number. The keyless data API probe concerns the open-data dataset, not the filing flow, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that filing starts without an account, a documented file-number or ID entry path, and hands-on confirmation of an account-free start.
